title: Early diastolic–heart-rate recovery coupling fails to improve HbA1c prediction across two NHANES cycles
abstract: The prespecified HR-recovery × early diastolic-rebound interaction did not improve cross-cycle HbA1c prediction in selected treadmill completers: weighted MSE reduction -0.00011006 percentage-points squared (two-sample PSU-refit 95% interval -0.00745858 to 0.00371537).
